data.narrative:
Emerald AI is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Varun Sivaram that has raised $68M to date. The broader climate and energy sector comprises nine peer companies across public and private markets, including one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

Given the nascent stage and heterogeneous technical approaches across climate tech, peer-median valuation proved inapplicable; the filtered peer set lacked sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables to support reliable multiples. Stage-progression analysis was therefore the primary applicable method, applying a 2.5x multiplier to the $68M total raised as a baseline proxy. This methodology, standard for Seed-to-next-round progressions, implies a post-Seed valuation of $170M.

The triangulation yields a median valuation of $170M, with a reasonable range of $144M to $195M reflecting uncertainty inherent in single-method reliance. Key limitations include the absence of granular peer comparables at this stage and the early revenue profile typical of frontier-climate ventures, which limits comparable-company and DCF approaches. The valuation is most sensitive to realized progress on core technical milestones and subsequent funding environment conditions.
